specification.name: Core Tasks
specification.description: Module with Celery tasks for asynchronous processing. Contains tasks for sending emails and processing uploaded resumes.

component.name: Email Tasks
component.description: Tasks for sending email messages through Celery

task.name: send_confirmation_email_task
task.returns: Sending result with status and details

implementation.async_wrapper: Uses async_to_sync to wrap asynchronous function
implementation.error_handling: Logs errors and returns error status on failure
implementation.logging: Detailed logging of all email sending stages

task.name: send_password_reset_email_task
task.description: Sends email with password reset token through EmailService
task.returns: Sending result with status and details

implementation.async_wrapper: Uses async_to_sync to wrap asynchronous function
implementation.error_handling: Logs errors and returns error status on failure
implementation.logging: Detailed logging of all email sending stages

component.name: Resume Processing Tasks
component.description: Tasks for processing uploaded resumes using ParseService

task.name: process_resume_upload_task
task.description: Processes uploaded resume: saves to temporary file, parses through ParseService and creates database records
task.returns: Processing result with status and created resume ID

implementation.file_handling: Saves file to temporary directory with unique name
implementation.memory_management: Uses garbage collection to free memory after each stage
implementation.parsing: Uses ParseService to extract structured data
implementation.database: Creates resume and all related records (personal info, contacts, skills, experience, education)
implementation.cleanup: Automatically removes temporary files and frees memory after processing
implementation.error_handling: Handles parsing errors and database record creation with full resource cleanup
implementation.logging: Detailed logging of all processing stages

operation.name: _create_resume_with_data
operation.description: Creates resume in database with all data from ParseService

data_handling.experience: Processes dictionaries with keys: job_title, company, location, start_date, end_date, responsibilities
data_handling.education: Processes dictionaries with keys: degree, institution, location, graduation_date
data_handling.error_safety: Uses .get() method for safe access to dictionary keys

logging.summary: Logs data summary before starting operations
logging.progress: Logs progress of creating each data category Logs details of each created element Logs successful completion of all operations

dependencies.dependency: redis (separate DB index for Celery via REDIS_CELERY_DB)

error_handling.strategy: All tasks wrap operations in try-catch blocks
error_handling.logging: Detailed error logging with full stack trace
error_handling.cleanup: Automatic cleanup of temporary files on errors Database transaction rollback on record creation errors
